svg.title: Stage outputs for one SOLID development task
svg.desc: A rooted tree groups all twelve logical stage outputs into framing, design and planning, implementation and improvement, and review and delivery. Each output feeds the next active stage; the tree is not a mandatory directory layout.

g.data-full-text: One task delivery | Logical outputs stored in existing documents or named sections
g.text: Logical outputs stored in existing documents or named sections

g.data-full-text: 00 Scope + setup | Scope, baseline, | selected stages and | usable configuration
01 Business rules | Confirmed rules, | sources and flows, | acceptance scenarios, | open decisions
02 Domain model | Terms, relationships | and invariants
03 Robustness | BCE responsibilities, | sources, success and | failure coverage
04 Design views | Class / module | + sequence views | + state if required | Contracts + cross- | view consistency
05 Specification | Scope, acceptance, | design constraints | and test seams
06 Task slices | Verifiable tasks, | blocking edges and | slice acceptance
07 Implement | Code, actual checks, | coverage and gaps
08 Refactoring | Final code + current | views and regression | evidence, or a | justified retain | decision
09 Change review | Two-axis findings, | corrections and | current evidence
10 Architecture | Scoped change / | retain decisions, | maintenance | triggers
11 Final delivery | Linked outcomes, | evidence, decisions, | limits for the user

svg.text: A complete handoff, from scoped request to reviewed delivery.
Read stages in numbered order; each output feeds the next active stage.
Combine or skip stages with reasons. These are deliverables, not twelve required files.
